kjv: faith is the substance of things hoped for, the evidence of things not seen
mine: faith is the assurance of things hoped for, the conviction of things not seen
note: hypostasis can mean "substance/reality" (as at 1:3) or "assurance" (3:14); "elenchos" is proof or conviction. The KJV's philosophical "substance" is defensible but is usually now read as abstract.

kjv: and were persuaded of [them (the things promised)], and embraced [them]
mine: and greeted them (the things promised) from afar
note: TR adds "kai peisthentes" (and were persuaded); absent from all early manuscripts.

kjv: they were sawn asunder, were tempted, were slain
mine: they were sawn in two, they were killed with the sword
note: SBLGNT omits "epeirasthesan" (were tempted) with P46 and the Syriac; it sits oddly in a list of violent deaths and may be a corruption of "epristhesan" (sawn).
